paper.title: Algorithm 769: FORTRAN subroutines for approximate solution of sparse quadratic assignment problems using GRASP
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 23(2), 196 (1997); collected as ACM TOMS Algorithm 769
paper.note: The article is not read. The archive is netlib TOMS 769.gz, fetched inside the sandbox, sha256 431c7443...b98. The shipped RES (block 'output', cost of best permutation found) is the oracle.

field: numerics (combinatorial optimisation: quadratic assignment by GRASP)
stack: Fortran (netlib 769.gz driver.f and src.f, unpacked verbatim from the shell archive; authors' Doc/Makefile names epcf90 with PGI flags, which the sandbox does not have); built with GNU Fortran 16.2.0 (conda-forge) in the sandbox

claim.text: Cost of the best permutation found by GRASP for the 6-by-6 QAP test instance, seed 270001, 1000 iterations, alpha 0.25, beta 0.50, look4 -1, as printed in the shipped reference output RES. Registered tolerance: abs 0.5 (integer cost, exact match).

attempt: Built the authors' driver.f and src.f with gfortran (three commands, no source edit). The authors' Doc/Makefile names the proprietary epcf90 compiler with PGI-only flags (-sloppy -C -d5 -g -temp=/tmp -u), which the sandbox does not have, so the build is patched: the compiler is substituted and the flags dropped. This is a build-only patch: manifests pre and mid are identical. Two passes, each in a fresh run directory, data fed on stdin (driver reads unit 5). Both print 'cost of best permutation found : 4490' and best permutation 1 5 4 2 6 3, matching the shipped RES.

original_attempt.reason: The authors' Doc/Makefile as shipped runs epcf90, which is not installed in the sandbox (make: epcf90: No such file or directory, make_exit=2). No gqaps binary was produced. The compiler is proprietary PGI and is not on conda-forge, so the original Makefile build cannot run here.
